style.evidence: The candidate uses a heavy near-black outline (#16120e) all around and heavily inside the trunk, with only 3 very dark brown steps (#4d3b27, #3d2e1e, #2b2015) and 2 muted greens, making it look muddy and sticker-like compared to the rich 5-6 step ramps and tinted outlines of the Beodeul tree trunks.
